name: Place a restricted hold on a member account
description:
Look up the member by member number, open their profile, and click 'Place Account Hold'. This is a restricted function. Select the given account_no from the Account dropdown by its exact account number, select the given reason from the Reason dropdown (exact option text), and click Place Hold. Read back the confirmation reference shown after posting. This action is irreversible once posted.

Returns: confirmation_ref — Confirmation reference shown after the hold is posted.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found, already_on_hold.
